pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions during active price retracements; pyramiding is limited to confirmed momentum expansions exceeding 2 standard deviations.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a localized order-block retest combined with an annualized volume delta spike before authorizing any new market entry.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing stops once unrealized profit hits +$5.00 to protect capital, while scaling out increments to allow the core to run toward the $15-$30 target.
